name: JPMorgan Chase
title: 8-K · JPMORGAN CHASE & CO. EARNINGS RELEASE - THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

read.thesis: Earnings release shows net income $15.3B (EPS $5.57), $15.8B ex a $658M securities loss; CET1 13.9% and ROTCE 20% signal strong capital, but no supply-side or capacity signal applies to a bank.

triggers.label: Buybacks reduced this quarter
triggers.quote: In line with our hierarchy, we reduced share repurchases this quarter.

triggers.label: Client asset net inflows $263B
triggers.quote: flows were very strong with $263 billion of client asset net inflows.
